ios.NSLocalNetworkUsageDescription: Litch connects to your computers over SSH on your local network.
ios.NSCameraUsageDescription: Litch uses the camera to scan the pairing code on your computer.
ios.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Litch accesses selected photos to attach them to your messages.
ios.NSPhotoLibraryAddUsageDescription: Litch saves images to your photo library when you choose to save them.
ios.NSFaceIDUsageDescription: Litch uses Face ID to confirm sign-in approvals for your computer.
